'''Raze''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]<ref name="Codex" /> of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] who lived sometime during their [[Sith Wars/Legends|conflicts]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="Date" /> Sometime between [[3681 BBY]] and [[3630 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Raze attempted to rescue a [[Unidentified Mandalorian clan (Dantooine)|clan]] of the Empire's [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] allies from a group of twenty [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] on<ref name="Codex" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref> [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].<ref name="Codex" />

Raze [[Death/Legends|died]] in the fighting but was successful in slaying her opponents, and was honored by the Mandalorians with a ''[[kote ky'ram]]''&mdash;a Mandalorian death ceremony that saw them burn her body on a pyre and spend a [[Local day/Legends|night]] in celebration of the fallen's feats.<ref name="Codex" /> By 3630 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Raze was the only non-Mandalorian to ever have received the honor.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Raze was mentioned in the "Mandalorian Death Ceremony" Codex entry in Chapter XIV of [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']], the [[2015]] Digital Expansion to the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Codex" />
